name: 質問と施設情報をまとめる発見パネル
prompt: Create compact Japanese Lighthouse discovery panel matching Japanese mock layout and exact Japanese copy, while original screenshot controls icon anatomy and visible closing state. Pure #FFFFFF canvas/surfaces, clean thin neutral dividers. Top question group: header '施設について質問' Bold20/28 role, restore original THREE four-point sparkle cluster inside subtle pale green circle (large low-left, small upper, medium right), not mock's single outlined star. Input complete thin neutral rounded rectangle with placeholder '口コミには何と書かれていますか' Regular14/24 gray, small forest green circular submit with white shafted right arrow. Two complete white outlined unselected pill rows: 'どのような料理がありますか', '店内はどのような雰囲気ですか', Meiryo Regular14/24, never bold. Divider, then header '施設の情報' Bold20/28. Hours block label '営業時間', metadata '2週間前に確認' Regular12/16 gray. EXACT original closing state restored in red text '52分後に終了' followed dark '17:00〜20:30'; the mock's green status is wrong. This is static example, not live current hours. Original small shafted right arrow at right in slate. Thin divider. Website row at left restore original external-link glyph: open square with northeast arrow, NOT mock document icon. Text '公式サイト', metadata '施設の最新の案内を見る'. Divider. Call row restore original outlined telephone receiver WITH TWO curved ringing waves, NOT mock ID-card icon. Text '電話で問い合わせ', metadata '施設に直接確認する'. All support icons coherent #526173, no green bubbles behind info-row icons. Body/row/control text Regular14/24, metadata12/16, tracking0; only two section headings Bold. Small primary green gradient #174C36 to #1F6444 to #2D8F5E 135deg on submit, neutral white suggestions and info surfaces. Compact logical gaps, comfortable no clipping, all content within canvas, no card shadows, chrome, extra actions or invented data. Preserve source glyph anatomy and red closing status.
reviewNotes: Combined question/info panel reviewed: original three sparkles and shafted arrow restored, complete Japanese input/two unselected outlined pills, source red 52-minute closing state retained with 17:00-20:30 hours, external-link open-square/northeast-arrow and receiver/two-waves anatomy restored in slate. Native Japanese generic site/contact copy preserved; section headings Bold, body Regular, metadata subordinate. Static original example only, no live hours/contact, exact-font, owner or runtime claims.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
